elements.requirement: A nullity of marriage order granted in respect of a voidable marriage operates to annul the marriage only with respect to any time after the order has been made final.
elements.quote: A nullity of marriage order granted in respect of a voidable marriage shall operate to annul the marriage only as respects any time after the order has been made final

elements.requirement: A voidable marriage subject to a nullity of marriage order must, notwithstanding the order, be treated as if it had existed up to the time the order has been made final.
elements.quote: the marriage shall, notwithstanding the order, be treated as if it had existed up to that time

elements.requirement: Subsection (1) applies to a decree of nullity granted after 31 July 1971 as it applies to a nullity of marriage order, but with the phrase 'decree has been made absolute,' substituted for 'order has been made final,'.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) has effect in relation to a decree of nullity granted after 31 July 1971 as it has effect in relation to a nullity of marriage order, but with the substitution— (a) for “order has been made final,” of “decree has been made absolute,”

elements.requirement: Subsection (1) applies to a decree of nullity granted after 31 July 1971 with the phrase 'notwithstanding the decree,' substituted for 'notwithstanding the order,'.
elements.quote: and (b) for “notwithstanding the order,” of “notwithstanding the decree,

thresholds.what: The grant date after which a decree of nullity is subject to the provisions of subsection (1)
